headline: Apple could help you prove your iPhone photos aren’t deepfakes
summary: Apple is developing an iOS feature to verify iPhone photo authenticity. The "Apple Reference Image" system embeds provenance metadata at capture. This enables users to prove their photos are genuine iPhone shots, not deepfakes.

headline: ‘Zoomsday’ hack uncovered using fewer than 20 AI prompts
summary: Zoom patched a major security vulnerability that could hijack devices during meetings. Researchers discovered the flaw using fewer than 20 AI prompts. The exploit specifically targeted Zoom's annotation feature.

headline: Why your Amazon order confirmation emails have become so unhelpful
summary: Amazon order confirmation emails now list only item categories, not specific products. Customers noticed emails becoming sparse and less informative. This change may be linked to AI agents and data handling practices.

headline: GuliKit’s new Switch controller features next-generation anti-drift thumbsticks
summary: GuliKit launched the ES Max, a new wireless Switch controller with improved anti-drift TMR thumbsticks. This model is an upgrade from their previous budget-friendly ES Pro. Priced at $49.99, it offers a more affordable alternative to official Switch controllers.

headline: Domino's Announces the Domino, Its 'Next Generation' Pizza — Here Are First-Look Photos
summary: Domino's has finally launched a pizza named 'The Domino'. This marks the first time in 65 years the company named a pizza after itself. First-look photos of this 'next generation' pizza are now available.

headline: 'We Certainly Hope to Have a Discussion': Stargate, Independence Day Writer Wants to Reboot Doctor Who, After Report Claims He Wants to Bring Back David Tennant
summary: Screenwriter Dean Devlin confirmed his interest in rebooting Doctor Who. Reports suggest he aims to bring back David Tennant as the Doctor. The BBC is currently seeking new production partners for the iconic series.

headline: Hostel: Parts I & II Are Getting a 20th Anniversary Edition 4K Steelbook This Year – Here’s Where to Preorder It
summary: Hostel: Parts I & II are receiving a 20th Anniversary Edition 4K steelbook. The special edition is available for preorder from select retailers. Its release date is set for October this year.

headline: Lynx Preview: The Sci-Fi Manga Blending Blade Runner and Pluto
summary: An exclusive preview of the new sci-fi manga series, Lynx, is now available. Lynx promises to blend the best elements of Blade Runner and Pluto. This combination aims to create an appealing package for manga fans.

headline: Summer 2026 on course to be UK's hottest on record, says Met Office
summary: The Met Office predicts Summer 2026 will be the UK's hottest on record. Only average conditions are needed for August to break last year's record. This projection highlights a continuing trend of rising summer temperatures.

headline: Burnham 'confident' early release of PC Harper's killers can be halted
summary: Burnham is confident that the early release of PC Harper's killers can be prevented. The Prime Minister stated the justice secretary will present a plan in September. This plan aims to halt more early releases of offenders.

headline: Watch: Was Trump smuggled out of Air Force One in a catering truck?
summary: US media reports claim Donald Trump secretly exited Air Force One via a catering truck. This alleged maneuver aimed to avoid a threat to his life from Iran. A video report further details the unusual incident.

headline: Eclipse chasers scramble for glasses as stocks run low
summary: Specialist eclipse glasses are nearly sold out online ahead of the UK's major eclipse. Demand has surged for the country's most significant eclipse since 1999. Enthusiasts are scrambling to secure protective eyewear before the event.
